requirement: Account menu › Getting started: a progress ring and n/N count that follow the rail's rule, and the row leaves when every step is done or the account hid it

oracle.invariant: Web, no AI account: 2/3 (sign-in and appearance always done); desktop, no account, notifications off: 2/4. A connect published to the page copy moves the count to 3/4 without a reload; a disconnected row does not count; notifications turned on move it too. Every step done: no row. Hidden from the account menu: no row, whatever the count. Operator switch off: no row. No answer about the flags (no door): the row shows with the count it knows. The row's ring has stroke-dashoffset = C·(1−done/total).
